Type: implementation task
Work key: CX02.1
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: Effective metadata changes repeat the same field change per affected file (e.g. FlipAngle 52°→60° four times).

Acceptance criteria:
1. Identical (field, before value+source, after value+source) changes collapse into one row: "FlipAngle 52° → 60° · 4 files", with the files in a disclosure.
2. Changes that differ per file stay separate; mixed groups show each distinct change once.
3. The files-affected count and "Same value, new source" tag remain correct; phone layout has no horizontal scroll.

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console.sh` (new guarded probes, current source 0 failures) and, where noted, `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js (previewCard, byPath)
set.title: CX02.1: Group identical metadata changes across files
